cohort: Fifty females presenting with genital herpes symptoms at Saadan Hospital Allaho Chowk Johar Town, Lahore.
finding: Anti-viral drugs reduced genital herpes symptoms in 90% of cases, with a 1.2% transmission rate in cesarean deliveries and a 7% transmission risk in vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a lower neonatal herpes transmission rate (1.2%) compared to vaginal delivery (7%).
